title_sq: Shitet Vile ne Qender te Tiranes
description_sq:
Shitet vile individuale 2 kate,5 minuta larg qendres se Tiranes,ne kryqezmin e Rruges se barrikadave me Rrugen e Dibres.
Vila ka nje siperfaqe trualli prej 304 m2,dhe siperfaqe ndertimore 362.4 m2,e shperndare ne dy kate,me nje planimetri shume funksionale.
Eshte e organizuar ne nje oborr,ku mund te parkohen 2 autmojete,dhe nje kopesht te vogel ku jane mbjelle peme te ndryshme frutore.
Kati i pare eshte i ndare ne dy apartamente 2+1+2 tualete me nje verande te pebashket,dhe kati i dyte eshte i ndare gjitashtu ne 2 apartamente nje 2+1 +2 tualete,dhe nje 1+1+1 tualet.Te dyja keto apartamente, gjithashtu kane nje verande te pebashket.
Nje pjese e konsiderueshme e viles me siperfaqe 213 m2 eshte e regjistruar ne certifikate, si ndertese social ekonomike dhe pjesa tjeter prej 149.4m2 eshte e regjistruar si banim.
Kjo vile eshte e pershtatshme per lloje te ndryshme aktivitetesh,pervecse per banim,ajo mund te kthehet ne Bar,Restorant,Hotel,etj.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mund te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Villa for sale in the center of Tirana
description_en: Individual villa for sale, 2 floors, 5 minutes from the center of Tirana, at the intersection of the Road of barricades and the Road of Dibra. The villa has a land area of ​​304 m2, and a construction area of ​​362.4 m2, distributed over two floors, with a very functional floor plan. It is organized in a yard, where 2 cars can be parked, and a small garden where various fruit trees are planted. The first floor is divided into two apartments 2+1+2 bathrooms with a common veranda, and the second floor is also divided into 2 apartments, one 2+1 +2 toilets, and one 1+1+1 toilet. Both of these apartments also have a common veranda. A significant part of the villa with an area of ​​213 m2 is registered in the certificate as a social and economic building and the other part of 149.4 m2 is registered as a residence. This villa is suitable for different types of activities, except for living, it can be turned into a bar, restaurant, hotel, etc. For more information or a visit to the property, you can contact us.
